policies.name: Gate agent releases with evaluation evidence

actions: Present evaluation evidence to the release owner
Recommend remediation for failed quality, safety, latency, or cost gates
Keep deployment outside the starter until a release owner approves the evidence

rules.reason: Quality score is below the release target
Unit cost regressed by more than 25%
No approved baseline is available for comparison
Release requires an owner-approved policy exception

actions: Present scope and prerequisite evidence to the launch owner
Recommend owners for unresolved launch checklist items
Keep workspace creation, provisioning, entitlements, and scheduling outside the starter

rules.reason: The closed-won order has not been validated
The opportunity has complex implementation scope
No accountable launch owner is assigned

actions: Present the supporting account signals and matched reasons
Recommend an onboarding, risk, renewal, or expansion play for owner review
Keep CRM tasks, customer outreach, billing changes, and commercial actions outside the starter

rules.reason: The recommendation is supported by fewer than two signals
A renewal, expansion, or other commercial action is proposed
The account has a billing risk signal
The account has an open support escalation

actions: Present variance evidence to the data steward
Recommend investigation targets without changing source records
Keep corrections and certification outside the starter until human approval

rules.reason: Records are missing from one side of the reconciliation
The variance is classified as material

actions: Present completion evidence and open exceptions to the field-service owner
Recommend follow-up for documentation, parts, or warranty gaps
Keep billing, payment, scheduling, customer messaging, inventory writes, and closure outside the starter

rules.reason: A parts or inventory exception remains open
The case is explicitly marked for human resolution

actions: Present the redacted timeline and evidence index to the incident owner
Recommend owners for remediation and evidence gaps
Keep publication, ticket changes, and RCA closure outside the starter

rules.reason: Fewer than three incident evidence artifacts are attached
Sensitive data has not been confirmed as redacted
The proposed root cause is not supported by evidence
Remediation actions do not all have owners
The evidence package contains unresolved gaps

actions: Persist the decision in the ERP or AP queue
Require human approval for payment holds
Notify the invoice owner with matched policy reasons

rules.reason: Invoice and purchase order differ by more than 2%
Vendor appears on a restricted list

actions: Present extracted decisions, owners, and due dates for review
Recommend corrections to incomplete action records
Keep task creation, CRM writes, and external follow-ups outside the starter

rules.reason: At least one action has no accountable owner
At least one action has no due date
An external follow-up draft requires review
The meeting record contains sensitive content
The source context has not been approved for action extraction

actions: Present the recommended approved route and matched policy reasons
Request owner review before selecting a fallback with unresolved evidence
Keep model invocation and policy exceptions outside the starter

rules.reason: No approved model is available for the task
Expected quality is below the routing target
The proposed route requires a policy exception
The primary provider is not healthy
Estimated unit cost exceeds the task budget
Estimated latency exceeds the task budget
The fallback route has not been validated

policies.name: Route people operations cases for review

actions: Present only the minimum necessary case evidence to the assigned reviewer
Recommend manager, HR, payroll, or workplace review based on matched rules
Keep employee decisions and HRIS, payroll, identity, or messaging changes outside the starter

rules.reason: The requester identity is not verified
The applicable people policy check is incomplete
The case is classified as sensitive

actions: Create a case in the security queue
Preserve message evidence
Require analyst approval before quarantine or account actions

rules.reason: A user clicked the reported link

policies.name: Gate production changes by operational risk

actions: Update the change record
Attach rollback evidence
Require an accountable approver before deployment

rules.reason: Change is planned during peak hours
Change affects a security control or boundary

policies.name: Review source-backed research for CRM action

actions: Present citations and entity evidence to the account owner
Recommend research gaps for analyst follow-up
Keep CRM writes, task creation, and outreach outside the starter

rules.reason: Research uses fewer than two approved sources
The account entity match is not confirmed
The research includes a sensitive signal
At least one source is older than 30 days

actions: Present cited answers and confidence evidence to domain experts
Recommend owners for unsupported questions
Keep document export, CRM writes, and external submission outside the starter

rules.reason: Approved evidence covers less than 90% of questions
The draft contains sensitive answers requiring expert approval
No domain expert is assigned to review gaps
The supporting evidence has not been approved
Draft confidence is below the review target

actions: Create or update the ITSM incident
Page the on-call team for major incidents
Start stakeholder communications with a human owner
Present the escalation timeline, telemetry, and ownership gaps
Recommend action owners and evidence follow-ups
Keep external messages, support-system writes, and closure outside the starter

rules.reason: The escalation is classified as critical
An external customer update requires review
The escalation timeline is not synchronized
